name: death-road-to-canada
features: 480x360 logical rendering for intro, menus, gameplay, camera, and touch mapping
Flurry analytics initialization, lifecycle, user-id, and event cleanup

notes: Arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, or both are supported; every present libmain.so is inspected and any unrecognized ABI fails closed.
Native edits are constrained by ELF mapping, canonical SHA-256, and exact original-or-patched instruction bytes.
Flurry methods are selected by complete DEX class, method, and descriptor identities.
A physical-device analog pulse kept the same selection; the visible color-cycling highlight also continued after D-pad input and while idle, so no guarded controller defect was isolated.
A reported 48-pixel black strip was Android's visible status-bar inset; a cold launch restored and retained the full 1280x960 surface, so no renderer workaround is applied.
Play Games and license checks are preserved; source-specific branding remains framework-owned.
